# Business brief

> **What:** why Campaign Planner exists and the outcomes it serves
> **Read when:** deciding whether a feature is worth building

Agency teams plan social campaigns for clients in spreadsheets. Campaign Planner replaces
the spreadsheet with one place to plan, schedule and approve posts.

### OUT-CAMP-001 · Campaigns are planned in one place

- **Owner:** product-owner

Measured by: every active client campaign lives in the app, not in a spreadsheet.

### OUT-CAMP-002 · Clients approve content faster

- **Owner:** product-owner

Measured by: median approval time under one working day.
